description: This file defines the NumberFormat class, which is responsible for parsing style attributes related to number formats from XML data in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It extends StyleBase and provides a method to interpret style attributes, particularly handling date formats and other numerical formats.

classes.name: NumberFormat
classes.description: Class for parsing and interpreting number format styles from XML attributes in PHPSpreadsheet.

methods.name: parseStyle
methods.description: Parses style attributes from a SimpleXMLElement, converting certain format strings and returning an array with style information.
